name: support-sla-guarantee
title: Support SLA Guarantee
description: An operational commitment banner detailing response times, ticket severity levels, and on-call escalation.
designRules:
# Design System

Genre: Industrial
Macrostructure: Stack
Density: Compact
Shape: Sharp
Motion: None
Typography: Grotesk
Color: Monochrome

## Rules

- Support Sla Guarantee Interaction: the interaction model is part of the design, not an add-on.
- Reduced motion replaces animation with a state change; nothing is hidden behind motion.
- The component composes through `cn` and never hardcodes colours.

## Avoid

- Reskinning this resource and republishing it under a new name.
- Adding shadows or radii that contradict its shape language.
